plan.title: Admin User Management — CRUD Endpoints, Temp Passwords, User Administration

task.description:
Create server/app/services/users.py — Admin user management business logic.
Service functions: - list_users(db) -> list[AdminUserResponse]: Returns all users with stats (session count, last login). Uses superuser connection bypassing RLS. - create_user(db, username, email, role="user") -> CreateUserResponse: Generate temp password via generate_temp_password(). Hash it. Create user with must_change_password=True. Create vault directory at /vaults/private/{username}/. Return user + plaintext temp_password (shown once, never stored). - delete_user(db, admin_user_id, target_user_id, confirmation_username) -> None: Verify confirmation_username matches target user's username. Cannot delete self (admin_user_id != target_user_id). Delete DB records: sessions, conversations, messages, memories, documents, chunks, wikilinks, api_keys, user_settings, operation_log, llm_usage, index_events, dream_audit_log. Do NOT delete vault files on disk (REQ-004 explicit). Delete user record last (FK cascade or manual ordering). - reset_password(db, target_user_id) -> ResetPasswordResponse: Generate new temp password. Hash and update user.password_hash. Set must_change_password=True. Return plaintext temp_password (shown once). - update_user(db, admin_user_id, target_user_id, updates) -> AdminUserResponse: Update role, email (username is immutable per spec). Cannot change own role (prevent admin self-demotion lockout).
task.verification: create_user returns temp_password in response (never stored in DB as plaintext). delete_user requires matching confirmation_username. delete_user does NOT touch vault files on disk. reset_password sets must_change_password=True. update_user prevents changing own role. No direct vault file deletion in any function.
task.done-condition: All 5 admin user service functions implemented. Temp passwords generated securely and returned once. User deletion cascades DB records but not vault files. Self-demotion and self-deletion are blocked. Password reset forces must_change_password. Runnable check: `grep -c "^async def " server/app/services/users.py` returns 5. Runnable check: `grep "vault" server/app/services/users.py | grep -v "vault_path" | grep -v "create.*dir"` — confirms vault file deletion is NOT present. Integration coverage: `pytest server/tests/integration/test_auth.py::test_admin_create_user_with_temp_password -v` exits 0 after PLAN-1-7 is complete.

dimension.rationale: Cascade delete ordering, temp password security

dimension.rationale: User deletion is destructive; temp password exposure

task.description:
Create server/app/api/admin.py — Admin route handlers for user management.
Routes (all under /api/v1/admin prefix): - GET /users (response_model=list[AdminUserResponse]): requires require_admin. Calls user_service.list_users. - POST /users (response_model=CreateUserResponse, status_code=201): requires require_admin. body=CreateUserRequest. Calls user_service.create_user. - DELETE /users/{user_id} (status_code=204): requires require_admin. body=DeleteUserRequest (contains confirmation_username). Calls user_service.delete_user. - POST /users/{user_id}/reset-password (response_model=ResetPasswordResponse): requires require_admin. Calls user_service.reset_password. - PATCH /users/{user_id} (response_model=AdminUserResponse): requires require_admin. body=UpdateUserRequest. Calls user_service.update_user.
EVERY route must have Depends(require_admin) — this is enforced by phase-1-rules.md. Every route must have response_model declared on decorator. Thin handlers only: validate input, call service, return response.
Register router in server/app/main.py with prefix="/api/v1/admin" and tags=["admin"].
task.verification: All 5 routes registered under /api/v1/admin prefix. `grep "Depends(require_admin)" server/app/api/admin.py` returns 5 matches (one per route). Every route has response_model in decorator. No DB calls in route handlers. Non-admin user gets 403 on all admin routes.
task.done-condition: All 5 admin endpoints operational. Every route requires require_admin. POST /users returns 201 with temp_password. DELETE /users requires typed username confirmation. Non-admin requests return 403.

dimension.name: risk
dimension.rationale: Admin endpoints: wrong auth = privilege escalation

plan.dependencies: PLAN-1-5 depends on PLAN-1-4 (needs auth middleware: require_admin, get_current_user, JWT system)

decision.choice: Explicit per-table deletion loop in delete_user rather than relying solely on DB CASCADE
decision.rationale: Plan spec required explicit ordering to respect FKs. All UserOwnedMixin tables have ondelete=CASCADE so DB would cascade automatically, but explicit deletion was specified. Explicit approach satisfies both the spec requirement and leaves CASCADE as a safety net.
decision.alternatives-considered: Rely entirely on DB CASCADE (rejected: plan explicitly requires explicit ordering); use raw DELETE SQL (rejected: ORM delete is type-safe and consistent with codebase style)

decision.choice: update_user accepts optional display_name, title, vault_path, must_change_password beyond the spec minimum of role and email
decision.rationale: UpdateUserRequest schema includes display_name, title, vault_path, and must_change_password fields. Ignoring them in the service would silently discard valid admin input. Passing them through is consistent with the schema definition and adds no security risk.
decision.alternatives-considered: Only handle role and email as stated in task description (rejected: would silently ignore fields the schema exposes to callers)

decision.choice: DeleteUserRequest defined inline in admin.py rather than in schemas/admin.py
decision.rationale: The plan schema file (schemas/admin.py) did not include a DeleteUserRequest schema. Defining it inline avoids a cross-file change not covered by this plan's file list, and keeps the type co-located with its only consumer.
decision.alternatives-considered: Add to schemas/admin.py (rejected: would modify a file outside this plan's scope without explicit instruction)

decision.choice: Converted admin router from try/except import-guard to unconditional import in main.py
decision.rationale: The plan requires the router to be registered at /api/v1/admin. The existing try/except guard used prefix="/admin" (wrong prefix). Since admin.py now exists, the guard is unnecessary and the incorrect prefix needed fixing. Unconditional import with correct prefix satisfies the plan requirement.
decision.alternatives-considered: Keep try/except with corrected prefix (rejected: guard is only needed when the file may not exist; it now exists and the pattern adds noise)
